Recorded claim:
Bug 1897010 followed the initial EWS header-fetch patch after Rust warnings caused a Brust Treeherder build failure. The follow-up marks future-proof match arms with #[allow(unreachable_patterns)] and unused work-in-progress bindings with underscore names. D210579 reviewer compared the patch to build errors and asked for one line to be formatted; the accepted review did not include an independent Rust build. This is a build lesson, not a recommendation to suppress warnings broadly. The unimplemented EWS branches remained unimplemented.

Provenance: a2d2167b9165ba46fe9139288bbf018046ad1fae686be02c8ec36e25fb51e038. Original evidence IDs: 4af142c900696c846665940260b2dc185a2d3ed4bfe8bf4dc4e85e868b646ec8, 5d1b4d823db1155d2bf4201a13b0607ddee6a0f0d305c7e2c5201eb8233ef918, 6142696f7ffc2f9d7d02df9fa67a55585e241de57461d763a76e6464b7078688.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.
